old: The applicant may be granted preferential naturalization.
new: The applicant may be granted simplified naturalisation.

old: Hungarian statutory statutes fully recognize dual citizenship.
Everyone has the right to address petitions to the authorities.
new: Everyone has the right to turn to the authorities with a request.

old: Constitutional obligations are expressed using impersonal dative predicates: *minden állampolgár kötelessége [főnévi igenév]* (it is the duty of every citizen to...), or *felelősséggel tartozik a társadalomnak* (owes responsibility to society).
new: You know the possessive -a/-e from A1. Duties are expressed with *X kötelessége* + an infinitive (*minden állampolgár kötelessége hozzájárulni …*, it is the duty of every citizen to …), or with *felelősséggel tartozik a társadalomnak* (owes responsibility to society).

old: I swear that I consider Hungary my homeland.
new: I swear that I will keep the laws.

old: I will be a faithful citizen of Hungary, and I will respect the Fundamental Law.
new: I pledge that I will respect the Fundamental Law.

old: I will defend the homeland according to my strength, and serve it according to my talents.
new: I swear that I will be a loyal citizen of Hungary.
